Name: Beach Life Aquaculture and Hydroponics
Author: Wizadroid
Description:
Welcome to Beach Life Aquaculture and Hydroponics, currently 3 machines are added consisting of a salt water aquaculture, freshwater aquaculture, and waterlogged hydroponics. These machines are used to create more of the crab pot catches as well as seaweed, and both green and white algae.

The machines:
[u]Waterlogged Hydroponics:
[/u]How to acquire recipe: Level 3 Fishing
Recipe: 10 Quality Fertilizer + 5 Iron Bars
Uses: Can generate more Seaweed, Green Algae and White Algae at the cost of 1 of the item and 1 basic fertilizer to produce 2-4 of said item.

[u]Freshwater Hydroponics:
[/u]How to acquire recipe: Level 6 Fishing
Recipe: 10 Quality Retaining Soil + 50 Bait + 5 Iron Bars
Uses: Can generate more freshwater life; Crayfish, Snail and Periwinkle at the cost of 1 bait.

[u]Salt Water Hydroponics:
[/u]How to acquire recipe: Level 8 Fishing
Recipe: 10 Quality Retaining Soil + 50 Deluxe Bait + 5 Iron Bars + 1 Calcite
Uses: Can generate more salt water life; Lobster, Clam, Shrimp, Oyster, Mussel, Cockle, Crab **NEW** Sea Urchins and Coral at the cost of 5 bait.

[u]Calcium Dust:[/u]
A new resource acquired at the bone mill by crushing up Nautilus Shells, Rainbow Shells, Limestone or Calcite.

[u]Calcification Tank:[/u]
How to acquire recipe: Level 9 Fishing
Recipe: 5 Battery Packs + 5 Iron Bars + 2 Gold Bars + 1 Limestone
Uses: Can generate more shells; Nautilus and Rainbow at the cost of 10 calcium dust.

[u]Pearlification Tank:[/u]
How to acquire recipe: Island trader for 5 pearls
Recipe: 5 Battery Packs + 10 Gold Bars + 5 Iridium Bars + 1 Radioactive Bar
Uses: Can generate more Pearls at the cost of 100 calcium dust and a week of your time.
